title: UN chief calls for Gaza ceasefire ahead of Oct 7 anniversary
summary: United Nations Secretary General Antonio Guterres on Monday called for a permanent ceasefire in Gaza ahead of the third anniversary of the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack on Israel.
